comments.author: MarcoS
comments.body:
base stats, iron panel
171v 313h, 14 turn, 14WR, 58 armour, 1400 dura, 300 crew

max mods 7/7 G6 iron panel 82 armour(142 armour with 3x20 plates). 1680 dura(in iron), 346 crew. and this superior ship isn't classed as the best of the superior ships.
We can't have these ships in Maris. Our cannons are incredibly weak compared to the other Asian UWO servers as we have the +10 cap to cannons. Incredibly difficult to melee, the SFCV actually has the lowest amount of crew (alongside SLaMort) compared to the superior battle ships and it still hits 346 crew. If these ships are added to Maris then just deck, PvP will just die and deck battle is the only way to counter these ships.

comments.author: MarcoS
comments.body:
i understand someone could misinterpret what im trying to say. Just because we could have god ships doesn't mean we should have god guns or forging cap raised, quite the opposite, i don't think we should have god ships or god guns. The gap between FS/current UWC ships we know is far too great. there's no weakness on these ships and breaks balance far too greatly and heavily leans towards UWO becoming pay to win which i despise. Also the superior and even improved superior cannons i'm very opposed to.

Maris has seen a large playerbase from the asian servers recently and korean players have also discussed how these superior ships and guns have damaged the pvp side on the korean server massively. sorry for the rant, i'm just very worried about the future of maris pvp with ships like these

comments.author: Edgedemon
comments.body:
while the numbers seem impressive, i see 10 more armour than ingermanland, and ~200 more dura than current top ships, i don't think that is enough to make them unsinkable, barely above the one hit kill threshold for current ships.

the crew does look a little exaggerated but aside from that is not THAT impressive.
